name: nicks-process-services-site
description: Nick's Process Services: hand-written pages (index, track, admin) plus Vercel functions in api/. The CSS inside each page is compiled from src/input.css (npm run build).

scripts.build: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/input.css -o build/site.css --minify && node scripts/inline-css.js
scripts.test: node scripts/check-inputs.mjs && node scripts/check-client-accounts.mjs && node scripts/check-security-stress.mjs && node scripts/check-2fa-legal-hold.mjs && node scripts/check-photo-metadata.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning scripts/check-real-handlers.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning scripts/check-passkeys.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning scripts/check-chaos-and-edge-cases.mjs
